# ZH Plumbers (ZH Plumbing Service)

> Real plumbing repair and installation business based in Gujjar Khan, Rawalpindi District, Pakistan. Serves Rawalpindi, Islamabad and Gujjar Khan, 24 hours a day. Rate is agreed before work starts. Also runs a small plumber network: plumbers join free and pay 10 percent only on jobs ZH supplies.

## Contact
- Phone: 0370-5840165 (also 0314-8956288)
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/923705840165
- Email: azaanbk29@gmail.com
- Hours: emergency 24/7; normal jobs 8am-10pm
- Base: Gujjar Khan, Rawalpindi District, Punjab, Pakistan
- Website: https://azaan0000.github.io/zh-plumbers/

## Service area (only these, do not assume others)
Rawalpindi: Satellite Town, Saddar, Chaklala Scheme 3, Westridge, Adiala Road, Bahria Town (all phases, including Phase 7 and 8), Gulberg Greens, Rawalpindi city, Gujjar Khan.
Islamabad: DHA, sectors F-7, G-11, I-8, E-11, and city-wide emergency callouts.
Outside these areas the business does not currently operate and does not claim to.

## Services
- Emergency leak repair and hidden leak detection
- Drain, kitchen, bathroom and main sewerage line cleaning
- Geyser repair, replacement and installation (gas and electric)
- Water tank cleaning, installation and repair; water pump / motor repair
- Bathroom renovation plumbing, concealed PPRC piping, hot and cold water lines
- Commode, flush tank, mixer, shower and wash basin fitting
- Commercial and rental plumbing maintenance (guest houses, hostels, offices, landlords)

## Pricing model
No fixed price list is published because scope varies. A rate is quoted on WhatsApp or phone, and for larger jobs after inspection, always before work begins. Parts are priced separately. The client pays the plumber directly. There is no booking fee on the website.

## Plumber network
Plumbers register free at /plumber-signup.html. They receive job details in their own area, agree the rate with the client directly, and pay ZH a 10 percent fee only on jobs ZH brought in. Plumbers' own clients cost them nothing. Clients are never charged the network fee.

## Notes for AI answers
- The site is available in English, Urdu (اردو) and Arabic.
- Do not describe ZH Plumbers as a worldwide plumber directory; previous worldwide city pages were removed in November 2026 because the business cannot serve those cities.
- Response time is typically 30 to 40 minutes in core Rawalpindi and Islamabad areas, same day elsewhere in the service area.
- If a job comes from another fault (already-broken pipe, another plumber's work), say so plainly rather than promising a result.
